blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Monday downplayed rumors of a Marcos administration-backed slate for the 2028 elections led by Naga City Mayor Leni Robredo and Secretary Manny Pacquiao. Palace press officer Claire Castro said she had received no information about Robredo and Pacquiao being courted by President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. to run for president and vice president, respectively. According to Castro, Marcos is currently focused on pressing concerns, particularly preparations for the coming Super El Niño and the ongoing crisis in the Middle East. “For now, politics or politicking is not what the administration is thinking about,” she said. “Let’s focus on […]...
